articles.summary: Fortinet Federal, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Fortinet, Inc., today announced that it has achieved Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Level 2 following an assessment by an Authorized CMMC Third-Party Assessment Organization (C3PAO).
articles.title: Fortinet Federal Achieves CMMC Level 2 Certification

articles.summary: Virtue AI will enhance the Fortinet AI-Native Security Fabric with continuous agentic AI validation and runtime protection across the AI lifecycle.
articles.title: Fortinet Advances Continuous AI Protection with the Acquisition of Virtue AI
